the gas chromatography mass spectra of volatile products of organic perovskite thin film and full cell decomposition are unique to each precursor or composition and that these spectra can be used to identify the thermal decomposition pathways.

the low cost polymer/gas stack encapsulation is the simplest of the approaches to pass the IEC 2016 Damp and Humidity Freeze test, and that the signature volatile products of organic hybrid peroskites are CH3I, NH3, and CH3Br.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a simple, effective, low cost packaging scheme to protect PSCs.
the thermal degradation and encapsulation of multi cation and multi halide organic hybrid perov-skite solar cells (OHPSCs).
understanding the thermal degradation of organic hybrid peroxkite solar cells and with improving their stability by developing low cost encapsulation techniques.

the low cost polymer/gloss encapsulation developed in this study is effective in preventing moisture ingress into perovskite devices and in suppressing outgasing, which limits decomposition of organic hybrid PScs by allowing these decomposition reactions to come to an equilibrium.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the GC MS results revealed the signature volatile products of organic hybrid peroskite decomposition under thermal stresses, and the results of GC MS confirmed that the pressure tight encapsulation scheme we developed is effective to suppress such outgassing, thereby limiting decomposition of perovskities.

GC MS analysis can be applied to evaluate the effectiveness and stability of different encapsulation techniques, coatings, and material compositions aimed to limit light and thermal degradation of perovskit solar cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GC MS is a useful technique to probe the decomposition of perovskitic materials, and it can be used to assess the effectiveness of encapsulation strategies.
the outgassing of volatile decomposition products is a key factor that limits the thermal decomposition of organic hybrid PScs.
the outgassing of perovskities can be suppressed with a low cost polymer encapsulation scheme that can be used for IEC photovoltaics standard testing.
